newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - European ADRs rally on oil earnings.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - European ADRs rally on oil earnings.

text.p: European oil companies saw their American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rise in active trading amid a string of good earnings reports this week, dealers said Wednesday.
"The energy group is very, very strong across the board," said one dealer. "There's a very positive sentiment."
Royal Dutch Petroleum was up 1 at 57-1/16 on a volume that ranked it among the most heavily traded on the New York Stock Exchange as the company prepared to release its earnings on Thursday.
Spain's Repsol SA was 5/8 up at 40-1/8 after reporting a net profit of 71.20 billion pesetas for the first half of the year against 65.71 billion the previous year.
British Petroleum Co Plc was up 2 at 85-3/4 after reporting strong earnings on Tuesday.
French oil companies also rode the wave of trading with Elf Aquitaine going 1-1/16 higher at 54-3/4 and Total SA up 2-3/16 at 50-1/4.
Telecommunications companies were also upbeat in Latin America.
"All of the markets (in the region) are up," said another dealer.
Brazil's Telebras jumped 5-5/8 to 139-5/8 following news that the government will issue a single bid document for next year's privatization of the company.

Following a series of confirmations from banks and other firms that the stock was still worth a buy rating, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter upgraded a unit of Telebras called Telemig to outperform from neutral.
Telefonos de Mexico was 3/16 higher at 55-9/16 and Venezuela's CANTV was 11/16 up at 43-11/16.
Amid foreign stocks, Canada's Newbridge Networks Corp fell 4-9/16 to 46 after preliminary estimates showed its first quarter figures would not meet analysts' expectations.
Gemstar International Group Ltd was up 1-7/8 at 18 a day after the technology company released its first-quarter results.
On Wednesday, Ciba Specialty Chemicals Holding AG said it would offer American Depositary Shares (ADSs) from August 11.

Spun off by Swiss pharmaceutical giant Novartis earlier this year, the company said two ADSs will equal one ordinary share with a nominal value of 10 Swiss francs and will be traded under the symbol CSYCY. (There is no technical difference between ADRs and ADSs.)
Advancers led decliners 298 to 223 among 814 ADRs. The ADR group rose 0.41 percent and volume totaled 48.0 million ADRs.
ADRs enable U.S. trade of foreign shares.
